scientific_integrity: Result uses elementary induction, generalized Chinese remainder theorem and integral homotopy of joins. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Directed broadcast-plus-disjoint-cycles with positive outdegree and pairwise-coprime cycle-length quotients only; complex is disconnected due to initial broadcaster support. No converse classification or extension to arbitrary digraphs, chip configurations, or sinks is asserted. Finite verification complements an infinite-parameter proof.
title: Sharp chip-budget homology in directed-cycle broadcast avalanches
